data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.title: date
sections.question: date
sections.summary: a specific day of the month or year when something happens

senses.definition: a specific day of the month or year, written or said as a number or words
examples: She writes the date at the top of her homework.

answers.answer: She writes the date at the top of her homework.
A date tells you how hot or cold it is outside.
He listens to the date on the radio to hear music.
A date is a colour of the sky.

sections.title: evening
sections.question: evening
sections.summary: the part of the day between the afternoon and the time you go to bed

senses.definition: the part of the day between the afternoon and the time you go to sleep
examples: She watches television in the evening.

answers.answer: She watches television in the evening.
The evening is the part of the day before 12 o'clock.
Evening comes before the afternoon.
The evening and the morning are the same part of the day.

sections.title: morning
sections.question: morning
sections.summary: the part of the day from when you wake up until 12 o'clock

senses.definition: the part of the day from when you wake up until 12 o'clock (midday)
examples: He goes for a run in the morning.

answers.answer: She has breakfast every morning.
The morning is the part of the day after 12 o'clock.
Morning comes after the evening of the same day.
The morning and the afternoon are the same time of day.

sections.title: night
sections.question: night
sections.summary: the dark part of the day when most people sleep

senses.definition: the part of the day when it is dark and most people are asleep
examples: She reads a book before she sleeps at night.
He works at night and sleeps during the day.

answers.answer: She reads a book before she sleeps at night.
Night is the brightest part of the day.
Night is between the morning and the afternoon.
Night is the same time as midday.

sections.title: today
sections.question: today
sections.summary: on this day; the day that is happening now

senses.definition: on this day; used to talk about the day that is happening now
examples: She has a test today at school.

answers.answer: She has a test today at school.
Today means the day before yesterday.
Today is the same as tomorrow.
Today means next week.

examples: She has a dentist appointment tomorrow.
Tomorrow is Tuesday, so today is Monday.

answers.answer: She has a dentist appointment tomorrow.
Tomorrow means the day before today.
Tomorrow is the same day as today.
Tomorrow means last week.

examples: She was ill yesterday and did not go to school.
Yesterday was Monday, so today is Tuesday.

answers.answer: She was ill yesterday and did not go to school.
Yesterday means the day after today.
Yesterday is the same as today.
Yesterday means next week.
